# GuideByCity

> City Guides, Cost of Living & Demographics

Explore 380+ US cities. Cost of living, income, housing, and city-to-city comparisons.

## Core pages
- [Methodology and data sources](https://guidebycity.com/methodology/): how every figure is derived, with primary-source citations
- [City directory](https://guidebycity.com/city/): browse every city we cover
- [Rankings](https://guidebycity.com/rankings/): city ranked by the key metric
- [Compare](https://guidebycity.com/compare/): side-by-side comparison
- [About and editorial standards](https://guidebycity.com/about/): authorship and review policy

## Data
- Primary sources: U.S. Census Bureau, U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
- All figures are derived from these primary sources; see /methodology/ for derivation and vintage.
